annotation.title_clean: SCULPTING THE LEGAL LANDSCAPE: EXPLORING THE COMPLEX INTERPLAY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE, HARDWARE, SOFTWARE, AND ROBOTICS
annotation.title_en: Sculpting the Legal Landscape: Exploring the Complex Interplay of Artificial Intelligence, Hardware, Software, and Robotics
annotation.venue: Human(ities) and Rights | Global Network Journal
annotation.summary_en: Conceptual journal article on the Fourth Industrial Revolution, distinguishing hardware, software, AI and robotics, and examining growing human trust in intelligent robots. It surveys legal challenges at their intersection (privacy, copyright, liability, right to repair) and suggests avenues for solutions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Hardware, software, AI and robotics are distinct but synergistic components of the Fourth Industrial Revolution.
Robotics bridges digital intelligence and the physical world.
Trust in robots depends on reliability, predictability, appearance and ethical decision-making.
Each technology raises distinct legal issues such as right to repair, privacy, copyright and liability.
